newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen budget deficit seen at 0.9 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen budget deficit seen at 0.9 pct of GDP.

text.p: Turkmenistan's budget deficit for 1997 is seen at 0.9 percent of gross domestic product, a parliamentary spokesman in the former Soviet republic said on Monday.
The spokesman told Reuters parliament had approved the government's 1997 budget on Friday.
The 1997 budget supposes income of 4,989 trillion manat and spending of 5,055 trillion manat.

The budget's volume is around double 1996 spending as the energy-rich nation of 3.8 million, which borders Iran and the Caspian Sea, expects to nearly double exports of natural gas in 1997 to 40 billion cubic metres.
